lines.text: The angel wakes Zechariah, who sees a solid gold lampstand with seven lamps and two olive trees beside it.
Zechariah says he does not know what these are, and the angel says not by might but by My Spirit.
The great mountain will become a lake before Zerubbabel, who will bring forth the capstone.
Zerubbabel's hands laid the foundation, and the seven eyes of the LORD will weep at the plumb line.
Zechariah asks about the olive trees and branches by the gold pipes, and the angel says two anointed ones.
